rv.q: Van Hove’s brutalist concept may evoke the despicable Don but not the divine Mozart.
This season's production of "Don Giovanni" resonate beyond all expectations.
Van Hove has taken us for quite a ride.
Van Hove’s production has a disruptive, at times enervating effect on the performance.

cn.t: Van Hove's brutal, joyless production divides critics, with most finding it visually unappealing and emotionally cold. However, the stellar Mozart cast and Nézet-Séguin's musical leadership win widespread praise.
